name: Zan.Ai
description: Official full-stack AI runtime, LLM clients, RAG vector pipelines, MCP protocol client, and knowledge indexing for Zan

name: Zan.AppUpdate
description: Universal application updater, release packager, zip compression, progress tracking and MD5 tamper-detection self-healing for Zan

name: Zan.Barcode
description: Barcode and QR for Zan: the full QR Code model 1-40 codec (ISO/IEC 18004 - numeric/alphanumeric/byte segments, automatic version selection, Reed-Solomon over GF(256), mask penalty scoring) plus a scanner that reads QR codes back out of images (finder and alignment pattern detection, rotation and perspective correction, format-info BCH recovery, block de-interleaving and error correction) - pure Zan, no reflection, no native dependencies

name: Zan.Bench
description: Micro-benchmarking for Zan: warmup plus repeated measurement on a monotonic clock, median-led statistics (median/mean/min/max/stddev/ops-per-second), parameterized cases with type-preserving generics, text and JSON reports, and baseline comparison with a noise threshold - pure Zan, no reflection, no native dependencies

name: Zan.Browser.Firefox
description: In-process embedded Firefox (Gecko) runtime and AI Agent automation for Zan: native C-ABI embedding, deterministic hardware anti-detect fingerprinting, multi-store isolation, and semantic DOM control

name: Zan.Caching
description: Caching for Zan: in-process LRU + TTL MemoryCache<T> (O(1) hit/evict, slot reuse, zero steady-state allocation, optional sliding expiration, opt-in mutex), a minimal IStringCache backend contract, and a two-layer read-through/write-through LayeredCache over it - pure Zan, monotonic-clock TTL, no native dependencies

name: Zan.Cli
description: Terminal output toolkit for Zan: ANSI styling (16/256/truecolor), width-aware tables, progress bars and interactive prompts — pure Zan, rendering is pure functions

name: Zan.Commercial
description: [experimental] Commercial licensing client module for Zan

name: Zan.Configuration
description: Configuration provider chain for Zan: memory, environment-variable, dotenv and JSON-file sources over one canonical key space (':' and '__' as equivalent separators, PascalCase segments), with typed reads and reload callbacks

name: Zan.Data
description: Data access for Zan: the System.Data connection/pool core, the System.Data.ORM (ZanSql codegen ORM with bidirectional navigation — Include for parent joins, Children/ChildrenOf for the derived reverse relation — and transaction savepoints), native-wire drivers for MySql/Postgres/SqlServer/Sqlite/Firebird/TDengine/ODBC, Redis client, the embedded ZanDb document store, and Xlsx reading

name: Zan.DataFrame
description: Pure-Zan tabular data core: columnar DataFrame with type inference, filter/sort/groupby-agg/hash-join; CSV IO via Zan.Csv

name: Zan.Desktop
description: OS desktop and system integration for Zan: clipboard/tray icon/screen/message box (System.Windows), input hooks/hotkeys/mouse/keyboard (System.Input), audio playback (System.Media + the System.Audio compat entry), UI automation (System.Automation), drawing primitives and printing (System.Drawing), and WMI system information/registry/scheduler (System.Management)

name: Zan.Diagnostics
description: Process control, Windows service integration and server observability for Zan: spawn/control/list child processes, SCM service snapshots, privilege checks, structured logging, and request/SQL/slow-path metrics — no native dependencies

name: Zan.Drawing
description: 2D drawing primitives, image buffer, pixel operations, raw document printing (System.Drawing), and image decoding/caching (System.Drawing.Imaging.ImageCodec)

name: Zan.Formats
description: Unified multi-format serialization suite for Zan: BSON, CBOR, MessagePack, Protobuf wire, TOML, YAML, and RFC 4180 CSV

name: Zan.Game
description: Comprehensive 2D/3D real-time game engine, physics, audio, ECS, scene graph, server, and gameplay kits for Zan

name: Zan.Game.Arpg
description: ARPG gameplay, Diablo/Legend-style combat, equipment affixes, inventory, and skills

name: Zan.Game.Board
description: Grid board games, tile states, turn steps, and board game mechanics

name: Zan.Game.Cards
description: Turn-based card battles, deck management, discard piles, and card effects

name: Zan.Game.Factory
description: Automation and simulation systems including conveyor belts, recipes, and logistics networks

name: Zan.Game.Idle
description: Idle and incremental game systems, offline progression, and production multipliers

name: Zan.Game.Tactics
description: Turn-based tactical grid combat, movement points, action points, and pathing

name: Zan.Globalization
description: Key-based localization (Lang, Apple .strings-style), Lunar calendar with ganzhi/zodiac, and lenient date parsing with pattern formatting for Zan — pure Zan, no native dependencies

name: Zan.Gui
description: The Zan GUI toolkit: HTML+CSS markup grown into a retained control tree, CSS styling/skins, two-way data binding, App/window shell, control library (inputs, tabs, menus, ChatView, ...), text shaping, media and the platform backend shells, with skins/icons/native driver bundles riding in src/Gui. Charts, DataTable, CodeEditor, Browser and Designer are the sibling Zan.Gui.* packages

name: Zan.Gui.Browser
description: In-app web browsers for Zan Gui: FirefoxBrowserBox on embedded Firefox (Gecko), CefBrowserBox on Chromium (CEF), and WebViewBox on system WebView (WebView2/WebKitGTK), with AI Agent automation, cookie and deterministic anti-detect fingerprinting

name: Zan.Gui.Charts
description: Rich 2D/3D business charts & data visualization suite for Zan GUI (Line, Bar, Pie, Scatter, Heatmap, Radar, Polar)

name: Zan.Gui.CodeEditor
description: Code editing components for Zan Gui: syntax-highlighted CodeEditor with completion/intellisense/debug integration and read-only CodeBlock

name: Zan.Gui.DataTable
description: Enterprise data grid for Zan Gui: DataGrid/DataTable with column model, sorting/filtering (incl. filter builder and filter tree), computed cells, pivot/transpose, master-detail, transactions, HTTP/local data sources, xlsx export and multi-language UI

name: Zan.Gui.Designer
description: Visual form and window designer subsystem for Zan GUI: WYSIWYG canvas, property inspector, undo/redo, document snapshot serialization, and HTML code generation

name: Zan.Gui.Workplace
description: IDE and professional workplace components including multi-panel docking, AI chat, console, file tree, and inspector

name: Zan.Hosting
description: Application hosting for Zan: IHostedService lifecycle contract, BackgroundService periodic-loop base class (exception-tolerant loop, per-tick timing, cancellation on stop, bounded join), and AppHost ordered start / reverse-order stop with per-service stop timeout, failure accounting and a typed status snapshot - no reflection, no codegen, pure Zan, no native dependencies

name: Zan.Industrial
description: [experimental] Industrial HMI & SCADA components for Zan GUI (Gauges, Trends, Alarms, Equipment Panels)

name: Zan.IO
description: Extended I/O for Zan: Path helpers, text streams, memory/mapped streams, INI, known folders, shortcuts, directory trees, file watching, and the compression family (Zip/GZip/Deflate/BZip2/Tar/Crc32) — pure Zan, no native dependencies

name: Zan.Jobs
description: Background job queue for Zan: durable task store with an append-only event log and restart replay, explicit handler registration (no reflection), retry with exponential backoff and jitter, delayed and recurring schedules, dead-letter handling, and observable job state - pure Zan, single-process writer, no native dependencies

name: Zan.Json
description: JSON contract layer for Zan: JSON Schema validation (draft 2020-12 subset), JSONPath queries and RFC 6902 JSON Patch application over System.Json.JsonValue - pure Zan, no native dependencies

name: Zan.Kafka
description: Pure Zan asynchronous Apache Kafka wire protocol client — zero external dependencies, high-performance binary framing, CRC32C hardware-accelerated integrity, topic metadata resolution, multiplexed connection pooling, RecordBatch v2 streaming producer and consumer

name: Zan.Linq
description: LINQ-style sequence operators for Zan: Enumerable query extensions, expression trees (Expr/ExprNode), grouping and stream pipelines — pure Zan, no native dependencies

name: Zan.Mapping
description: Explicit object mapping for Zan: typed mapping profiles with named member rules and per-member error attribution, reusable value converters, and a code generator that turns compile-time entity metadata into plain mapping functions - pure Zan, no reflection, no boxing

name: Zan.Messaging
description: In-process messaging for Zan: typed channels with publish/subscribe and command semantics, request-response endpoints that keep the result type intact, and a middleware pipeline with explicit error routing - pure Zan, no reflection, no runtime type names required

name: Zan.Mvc
description: [migration-in-progress] Enterprise Web MVC framework and admin console for Zan: controllers, ORM + cache, RBAC auth, job host, metrics, in-memory views

name: Zan.Net
description: Pure-Zan networking for Zan: TCP/UDP sockets, the managed TLS stack, HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 client and server, reverse proxy and forwarder, WebSocket/WSS, SSE, MQTT, CoAP, Modbus, NTP, SIP, WebDAV, ping and NIC enumeration — no native dependencies

name: Zan.Oss
description: Object storage for Zan: Aliyun OSS (V1 signature), Tencent COS (XML API signature) and S3-compatible (AWS SigV4) — put/get/head/delete, streaming get-to-file, public URL and credential check, pure Zan, no native dependencies

name: Zan.Pdf
description: PDF generation for Zan: composable pages with lines, rectangles and text, standard-14 font metrics for measurement and layout, tables with column widths and padding, and a PDF 1.4 writer with cross-reference table and document metadata - pure Zan, no native dependencies, no font embedding

name: Zan.RabbitMQ
description: Pure Zan asynchronous AMQP 0-9-1 client for RabbitMQ — zero external dependencies, connection tuning, channel multiplexing, exchange/queue declarations, publisher confirms, and high-throughput async consumers

name: Zan.Resilience
description: Resilience and fault-tolerance policies for Zan: CircuitBreaker state machine, TokenBucketRateLimiter, and RetryStrategy — pure Zan, no native dependencies

name: Zan.Resources
description: Resource packs for Zan: build and read bundled asset packs (ResourcePack/ResourcePackWriter) — pure Zan, no native dependencies

name: Zan.Scripting
description: In-process Lua 5.3/5.4 embedding for Zan (Lua/LuaValue) with the cross-platform native driver bundle — drivers auto-bundle on --publish

name: Zan.Sdk.Jd
description: JD open platform SDK for Zan

name: Zan.Sdk.Steam
description: Steam API SDK for Zan

name: Zan.Sdk.Wechat
description: WeChat official account, mini-program, work and pay SDK for Zan

name: Zan.Security
description: Pure-Zan cryptography for Zan: AES/SHA/MD5/HMAC/HKDF/PBKDF2/Keccak256, RSA/ECDSA/Secp256k1/Curve25519/BigInt, the Chinese national SM2/SM3/SM4 suites, X.509 certificates, JWT and OTP — no native dependencies

name: Zan.Ssh
description: SSH for Zan: RFC 4251 wire codec, RFC 4253 binary packet protocol with AES-GCM, version exchange, algorithm negotiation, curve25519-sha256 key exchange (RFC 8731), host key fingerprints and known_hosts verification, password/publickey authentication and exec channels - pure Zan, reuses Zan.Security crypto primitives

name: Zan.Tensor
description: Tensor primitives for Zan: multi-dimensional row-major tensors, element-wise and matrix operations, normalization/activation kernels, and a pluggable compute-backend seam for GPU acceleration — pure Zan, no native dependencies

name: Zan.Testing
description: Comprehensive unit testing framework for Zan: assertions, test runner, data fixtures and mock stubs

name: Zan.Text
description: Text processing for Zan: Markdown renderer, pinyin conversion with bundled data table, CP936/GBK codec, BM25 full-text search, fuzzy matching, text templates and tables, and the regex engine — no native dependencies

name: Zan.Validation
description: Declarative validation for Zan: rule chains, error aggregation, nested validation and JSON/text error views — compile-time bound property getters, zero runtime reflection

name: Zan.Web
description: Server web framework for Zan: WebApp/WebHost, Router, Controller and HTTP attributes, HttpContext, view rendering, validation, static files, API docs, menus, CSRF/rate-limit/permission plumbing, and WebSocket sessions — pure Zan, no native dependencies

name: Zan.Web3
description: Pure-Zan Web3 & Ethereum application protocol suite: EIP-55 Address, EIP-1559 Transactions, Account/Wallet signing, RLP serialization, ABI contract codec, and JSON-RPC 2.0 client tooling (built on Zan.Security)

name: Zan.Xml
description: XML DOM for Zan: recursive-descent parser (entities, CDATA, comments, PI, DOCTYPE), tree navigation with prefix-tolerant name lookup, and a compact/pretty writer with full round-trip — no native dependencies
